document:0:431:0.text:
Add these in order: starite powder, fish scale gel, and several drops of full moon dew.
Steps: First, pour a sufficient amount of <style="highlight">full moon dew</style> into a crucible.
Next, add the <style="highlight">starite powder</style> and stir it rapidly clockwise nine times with a silver stirrer.
Finally, add one teaspoon of <style="highlight">fish scale gel</style> and stir gently counterclockwise until faint sparks appear.

say:3:1622315002:0.text: And all that shiny stuff? How're we supposed to sleep with that blasting in our faces?
say:3:1622315002:0.source_cn: 弄些亮闪闪，俺们还睡不睡了​？

say:5:1622315004:1.text: You try to reason with them—it's almost summer, the days get longer, the nights get shorter, and none of it has anything to do with you.
say:5:1622315004:1.source_cn: 你尝试向它们解释：夏季临近，白昼逐日延长，黑夜相应缩短...
say:5:1622315004:1.male: You try to reason with them—it's almost summer, the days get longer, the nights get shorter, and none of it has anything to do with you.

say:6:1622315005:1.text: Don't care. All I know is I'm sleepy!
say:6:1622315005:1.source_cn: ​俺不听！什么天长地短，俺就知道困！​

say:7:1622315006:1.text: So sleepy I'm about to spin in the air! Look!

say:8:1622315007:1.text: So shut the shiny stuff off already!

say:9:1622315008:1.text: Or I'll holler loud enough to bring my uncle, my cousin, and whoever else hears me!
say:9:1622315008:1.source_cn: 不然俺就嗷嗷叫，把俺二姨父、三表哥全喊来！

say:0:1622316001:0.text: These two are hopeless... Forget it. No point wasting time with them.
say:0:1622316001:0.source_cn: 这俩憨傻的家伙……不跟它们纠缠了。
say:0:1622316001:0.male: These two are hopeless... Forget it. No point wasting time with them.
say:0:1622316001:0.female: These two are hopeless... Forget it. No point wasting time with them.

say:1:1622316002:0.text: Let's check the area. Water, plants, anything living here. Can't miss a single clue.
say:1:1622316002:0.source_cn: 先在周边巡查一圈，生物、水质……都不能遗漏。
say:1:1622316002:0.male: Let's check the area. Water, plants, anything living here. Can't miss a single clue.
say:1:1622316002:0.female: Let's check the area. Water, plants, anything living here. Can't miss a single clue.

say:1:1622317001:0.text: Friend, you're wondering if the nights have become shorter lately, aren't you?

say:1:1622317001:0.male: Friend, you're wondering if the nights have become shorter lately, aren't you?
say:1:1622317001:0.female: Friend, you're wondering if the nights have become shorter lately, aren't you?

say:2:1622317002:0.text: From what I've observed, the solstice is approaching. Light just reclaims a bit more of the sky each day...
say:2:1622317002:0.source_cn: 就我的观察，夏至渐近，光明正一丝丝地……织回自己的领地。

say:3:1622317003:0.text: It's normal. Nothing unusual compared to other years.
say:3:1622317003:0.source_cn: 昼长夜短之规律，较于往昔，并无显著异常。

say:5:1622317004:0.text: No thanks needed, friend. If your path ever gets foggy again, just come find me. My door's always open.
say:5:1622317004:0.source_cn: 无需言谢，狼友。如你前路仍有迷雾，找我即可，我的门扉永...

say:8:1622317005:1.text: Let me guess, those noisy flying bugs got you second-guessing yourself?

say:2:1622320002:0.text: That starglider totally tricked me... Its glow is weaker than the fireflies in the bushes...

say:7:1622320005:0.text: If we tell him we came up empty, that blockhead's gonna hound me day and night until we actually find that starglider...
